gui.guhs.superkompas.pick: Click a place: your Super Compass shows the way!
gui.guhs.superkompas.quests.tooltip: Places where a guh quest begins

gui.guhs.eilanden.no_build: Nyeg! The floating guh islets are sacred: no breaking or building here.
gui.guhs.evenement.start.kaasregen: It's raining CHEESE NIBBLES! Run into them to catch them, before the wild guhs gobble them up. Watch out for the golden ones!
gui.guhs.evenement.start.parade: Boom boom! The CHONK PARADE is marching by! Walk along with the Drummer Guh all the way to the very end for a surprise. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.evenement.start.sterrenregen: Look up: a STAR SHOWER! Where a star lands, a star guh sometimes appears. Tame him quick, before he goes back to the stars!
gui.guhs.evenement.kaasregen.golden: A GOLDEN cheese nibble! No wild guh can resist that...
gui.guhs.evenement.kaasregen.end: The Cheese Shower is over! You caught %s cheese nibbles. Chonk!
gui.guhs.evenement.kaasregen.end_none: The Cheese Shower is over... and you didn't catch a single one. Nyeg! The guhs are very happy about it, though.
gui.guhs.evenement.parade.gone: The Chonk Parade has marched out of sight...
gui.guhs.evenement.parade.stopped: The Chonk Parade has stopped. Next time, walk along until the end!
gui.guhs.evenement.parade.too_late: The Chonk Parade is at the end! Next time, walk along the whole way for a surprise.
gui.guhs.evenement.parade.reward: You walked the whole way! The Drummer Guh gives you: %s (and cheese nibbles). Only at the parade!
gui.guhs.evenement.parade.title: WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.evenement.parade.subtitle: You get: %s
gui.guhs.evenement.sterrenregen.guh: A star guh landed with a star! Quick, feed him cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.evenement.sterrenregen.tamed: The star guh is staying with you, forever. Make a wish!
gui.guhs.evenement.sterrenregen.end: The %s is over. The last star guhs twinkle back up into the sky.
gui.guhs.evenement.not_here: Guh events only happen in the Guhmension.
gui.guhs.evenement.already: There's already an event near you!
gui.guhs.evenement.indoors: Events only happen outside, under the open sky (not in a building or underground).
gui.guhs.evenement.no_route: No room for a parade here: find a nice open field.
gui.guhs.evenement.command.none: You're not taking part in an event.
gui.guhs.evenement.command.when: Your next guh event: in about %s Minecraft days (%s Guhmension time).
gui.guhs.evenement.command.when_unknown: You haven't been to the Guhmension yet: your event clock isn't ticking yet.
gui.guhs.menu.emotes.tooltip: Make your guh wave, dance, sleep, jump, roll, munch, act shy, yawn, sing, cuddle, blow hearts, do a snuggle dance or a BFF hug. Pick a favorite emote too: he'll do it on his own every now and then.
gui.guhs.guheinde.terugpoort: Whoosh! The Return Gate floats you wahoog back to the big island. Toot toot!
gui.guhs.superkompas.einde.tooltip: On the way to the Guh End. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guheinde.oog_alleen_guhmensie: Nyeg... the Eye of Chonky only blinks in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.guheinde.oog_niks: The eye looks around, confused. There's no Nibble Cellar to be found here
gui.guhs.guheinde.oog_kapot: NYEG! The Eye of Chonky broke. There's Mika Tear in it, that explains a lot
gui.guhs.guheinde.portaal_open: Twelve Eyes of Chonky stare at you... The portal to the Guh End opens. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.subtitel: Where all the nibbles went. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guheinde.aankomst: Hear that? NYEG NYEG NYEG! Overlord Mika is coming on his poor, starving Enderguh!
gui.guhs.guheinde.kristal_kapot: A Nibble Crystal broke: the nibbles rain back down! %s more to go.
gui.guhs.guheinde.uitgeput: All the Nibble Crystals are broken! The Enderguh is worn out and lands on Nibble Mountain... Give him a cheese nibble!
gui.guhs.guheinde.gevoerd: WAHOOG!!! The Enderguh finally has a nibble. He throws Overlord Mika off!
gui.guhs.guheinde.schat_open: Click-clack... Overlord Mika's nibble hoard under Nibble Mountain is open!
gui.guhs.guheinde.oproep: The Nibble Crystals are glowing... Overlord Mika can smell nibbles. He's coming back!
gui.guhs.guheinde.bewaard: The Mikas only snatched your cheese nibbles. You still have everything else. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guheinde.beloning.eerste: For you: the Nibble Crown, the Overlord Mika Trophy and your very own Wahoog Enderguh! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.beloning.ei: Overlord Mika leaves an Enderguh Egg behind. Place it and wait for it to hatch!
gui.guhs.guheinde.mika_huilt: The Mika Boss cries two big fat Mika Tears. Nyeg...
gui.guhs.guheinde.larfje.roof: A Mika Grub snatches a cheese nibble! Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guheinde.mager.honger: The skinny guh looks at you hungrily. Do you have a cheese nibble?
gui.guhs.guheinde.mager.vahoeg: G... guh? GUH! WAHOOG!!! Thank you, sweet hero! I'm running home!
gui.guhs.guheinde.enderguh.niet_meppen: Don't whack the guh! It's not his fault. Whack Overlord Mika!
gui.guhs.guheinde.enderguh.bang: The Enderguh is too scared of Overlord Mika. Smash the Nibble Crystals first!
gui.guhs.guheinde.enderguh.blij: The Enderguh happily flaps his wings. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.ei.0: The Enderguh Egg wobbles a little
gui.guhs.guheinde.ei.1: There's a little crack in the Enderguh Egg! You hear a soft 'guh'
gui.guhs.guheinde.ei.2: The Enderguh Egg is cracking! Just a little longer...
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.vloer: NYEH-HEH! As long as I'm riding my Enderguh, you'll never chonk me down!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.hulpjes: MIKAS! Over here! Grab those nibbles!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.lui: Fly, you lazy chonky beast! NYEG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.eraf: NYEEEEG! My Enderguh! Who gave him a nibble?!
gui.guhs.guheinde.opper.roof: Overlord Mika snatches %s cheese nibbles from you! Nyeh-heh!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal1: Guh... Welcome, hero. I must tell you something. The cheese nibbles in my kingdom are running out. Everywhere. My guhs are turning gray and skinny.
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal2: It's Overlord Mika, the boss of all Mikas. He snatches them and takes them to the Guh End, an island far, far away. Without nibbles, no guh is wahoog!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal3: Make an Eye of Chonky: a guh crystal, a cheese nibble and a Mika Tear. Mikas cry sometimes, especially Big Mika and the Mika Boss. Throw the eye in the Guhmension: it flies toward a Nibble Cellar.
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.verhaal4: In the cellar there's a portal. Fill it with twelve eyes and bring the nibbles back. Here, read this book. Chonk on, hero!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.hint_traan: No Eye of Chonky yet? Make Mikas cry: Big Mika in the Challenging Guh Caves cries the hardest. Or beat the Mika Boss three times with CHONK.
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.hint_oog: Throw your Eye of Chonky in the Guhmension and follow it. Where it dives down, dig for the Nibble Cellar!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.ridder1: You did it! Overlord Mika is chonked and the nibbles are coming back. Kneel, hero...
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.ridder2: *tap tap with a cheese nibble* I dub thee Knight of the Guh End! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.guheinde.koning.dank: Knight! Thanks to you, my guhs are wahoog again. Will you come by for a nibble sometime?
gui.guhs.superkompas.ondergrond.tooltip: Deep under the Guhmension, in the holey cheese. Shhh!
gui.guhs.vadswoud.baby_getemd: WAHOOG! The baby guh wants to come with you!
gui.guhs.vadswoud.baby_bessen: Nom, nibbleberries! The baby guh grows a little bit.
gui.guhs.vadswoud.alleen_babys: Nyeg, nibbleberries are for baby guhs. Big guhs want cheese nibbles!
gui.guhs.vadswoud.slaapt: %s is sleeping snugly in the guh nest. Zzz...
gui.guhs.vadswoud.reuzenboom: WAHOOG! A giant guh tree grew from your saplings!
gui.guhs.superkompas.barbecue.tooltip: Everything for barbecuing, from the Guhmension all the way into the Barbecuether
gui.guhs.seizoen.sneeuwpop: A snowman guh! He looks at you super happily.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.lente: Spring! Put three flowers on the season planter for a blossom wreath.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.zomer: Summer! Put three wheat on the season planter for a straw sun hat.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.herfst: Fall! Jump into the leaf piles. Four leaves on the season planter: leaf piles for at home.
gui.guhs.seizoen.tip.winter: Winter! Three wool: a cozy scarf. Three snowballs: a Snowguh Head.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.stap.gemaakt: done, bring it to the mayor!
gui.guhs.knusfeest.stap.gestolen: stolen by a Crumb Mika! Follow the crumbs...
gui.guhs.knusfeest.lijst_klaar: There are no party chores right now. Come back to Mayor Chonkworth next season!
gui.guhs.knusfeest.lijst_leeg: The list is still empty. Talk to Mayor Chonkworth on the square in Snuggledale first.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.hint: ! = you have it with you, ? = stolen: follow the crumbs
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.beschermd: Nyeg! Snuggledale is so cozy, nothing here can change.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.welkom: Welcome to Snuggledale! Mayor Chonkworth is standing on his steps in the square. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.titel_gekregen: %s is now Snuggle Mayor of Snuggledale! WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.oorkonde: For the Snuggle Mayor, with thanks from all of Snuggledale. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.seizoensfeest_klaar: What a cozy season party! Mayor Chonkworth waves you goodbye. See you next season!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.gedekt: The buffet is set! Put something yummy on it: pastries, harvest, tea, cheese milk or cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.leeg: A party buffet table. During a Cozyfest it's full of yummy treats!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.zelfgemaakt: Homemade! %s is on the buffet now. The guhs look at it all chonky.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.buffet.erop: %s is on the buffet now. Nom!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.feest.groot: THE GREAT COZYFEST! All the guhs are coming to the party buffet. Put something yummy on it yourself, too!
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.feest.seizoen: The season party begins! The guhs are coming to feast at the party buffet.
gui.guhs.knuffeldal.feest.einde: The party is over. Everyone is full, chonky and very, very wahoog.
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.gestolen: *giggle* A Crumb Mika snatches your %s and runs off! Follow the crumbs...
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.gelokt: The Crumb Mika sniffs at your treat... he forgets all about his loot! Give him the treat (right-click).
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.zonder: *giggle* No treat, no loot, nyeg! (cheese nibbles or pastries)
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.terug: The Crumb Mika gobbles up your treat and lets go of your %s! He runs off giggling.
gui.guhs.kruimel_mika.niet_meppen: Nyeg, no whacking! You lure Crumb Mikas away with a treat.
gui.guhs.evenement.start.knusfeest: It's Cozyfest! Everyone to the party buffet, with all your guhs!
gui.guhs.superkompas.knus.tooltip: Cozy little spots: Snuggledale, the farm, the observatory, the balloon festival...
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.lente: The Guhmension is blooming: it's SPRING! The planters in Snuggledale are full of blossoms. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.zomer: The sun is shining all chonky: it's SUMMER! Time for sun hats in Snuggledale.
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.herfst: The leaves are falling: it's FALL! The leaf piles in Snuggledale are big again. Jump in!
gui.guhs.seizoen.wissel.winter: Brrr, it's WINTER! Scarves on and build snowman guhs. Nyeg, so cold!
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feesttaart: Baker Crusty bakes it in the Nibble Bakery, on the north side of the square.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.theeservies: Mrs. Teaspoon lends it out after a snug tea party in the Nibble Tea House (east side).
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feestkapsels: Curly the Barber styles them during a festive salon show at Snip & Chonk (south side).
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feestslingers: Miss Snuggles' baby guhs craft them at the Snuggle Daycare (west side).
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.feestbloemen: Grow guh flowers in your own garden patch and make a party bouquet.
gui.guhs.knusfeest.waar.sterrenlantaarns: Professor Twinkle gives them to you when you connect a constellation at the Guh Observatory.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.voor_klant: That's for a customer! Right-click the customer to hand it over.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.voor_klant.tooltip: For one of Baker Crusty's customers
gui.guhs.bakkerij.vers: With fresh stuff from Snuggledale (farm and gardens) you bake one extra!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.wordt.nieuw: A new recipe?! Give it a try!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.wordt.feesttaart: This will be: the PARTY CAKE!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.wordt.geheim: Hmm... that looks like Crusty's secret recipe.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.geheim: Only Baker Crusty bakes the Party Cake recipe, for the Great Cozyfest.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.spatie: Space or OUT! when the needle is in the orange
gui.guhs.bakkerij.uitleg: Pick dough, shape and topping and slide it into the oven
gui.guhs.bakkerij.bakt: %s is in the oven... watch the needle!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.uit.spel: %s is ready (%s)! Quick, to the customer!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.geen_bestellingen: No customers yet... they're on their way!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.te_ver: You're too far from the oven.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.al_bezig: There's already something in the oven!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.te_weinig: You don't have enough ingredients for this recipe.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.andere_oven: Use the ovens of the bakery where you're playing!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.vergeten: You forgot about the oven... burnt, nyeg!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.play.tooltip: For two whole minutes you're the baker: help the customers get their orders
gui.guhs.bakkerij.shop.tooltip: Baker's outfit, your own Nibble Oven and baking things, for Bake Coins
gui.guhs.bakkerij.rules: Customers come in with a little cloud over their heads: that's what they want. Click a Nibble Oven, pick dough, shape and topping (or click an order), slide it into the oven and take it out when the needle is in the orange. Then right-click the customer! Three happy customers in a row: combo! Bake Coins buy you fun stuff.
gui.guhs.bakkerij.busy: %s is baking right now (%s seconds left, %s points). Come watch!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.first: The first time you get extra Bake Coins. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.bakkerij.free: The ovens are warm. Ready to bake?
gui.guhs.bakkerij.feest: Cozyfest! Score %s points and a party customer will come in for the PARTY CAKE.
gui.guhs.creche.knop.verzorgen.tooltip: Nice and calm: give three baby guhs a bottle and a diaper, tuck them in and sing a lullaby
gui.guhs.creche.knop.knutselen.tooltip: For the Great Cozyfest: the baby guhs craft party garlands, then it's the care round
gui.guhs.creche.knop.terugbrengen.toolti: The game: the baby guhs crawl away, bring them back to their cradles quick!
gui.guhs.creche.knop.stop.tooltip: Miss Snuggles takes over (in the game you still get your points)
gui.guhs.creche.knop.winkel.tooltip: Baby clothes, cradles and blankies for Pacifier Coins
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.uitleg: This is the Snuggle Daycare! Will you help me? Calm caring: bottle, diaper, blankie and a lullaby. Or the game: the baby guhs crawl away, bring them back to their cradles!
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.feest: The Great Cozyfest! The baby guhs want to craft party garlands for the mayor. Will you join the care round? Then they'll do their crafting first.
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.bezig: %s is helping me with the baby guhs right now. Just a moment, shh!
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.jij_verzorgen: You're doing the care round. Look above the cradles to see what the baby guhs want.
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.jij_terugbrengen: You're bringing them back! Quick, there goes one!
gui.guhs.creche.scherm.geen_best: No record yet. Try the game!
gui.guhs.creche.wens.slaap: to be tucked in with a snuggle blankie
gui.guhs.creche.slaapt_al: Shh! This baby guh is already asleep.
gui.guhs.creche.deze_slaapt: This baby guh just keeps on sleeping. Check the ones that are awake!
gui.guhs.creche.niet_jouw_spel: Nyeg, someone else is helping Miss Snuggles right now.
gui.guhs.creche.handen_vol: Your hands are full! (%s baby guhs at a time)
gui.guhs.creche.ontsnapt: Nyeg! Miss Snuggles had to bring one back herself.
gui.guhs.creche.klaar: Done! %s baby guhs brought back, %s points: %s Pacifier Coins.
gui.guhs.creche.record: New record: %s points (was %s)! +%s Pacifier Coins. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.creche.weggelopen: You walked out of the Snuggle Daycare. Miss Snuggles takes over.
gui.guhs.creche.gewiegd: Rock-a-bye... %s baby guh(s) grow a little. Zzz...
gui.guhs.creche.titel.klaar.sub: Any moment now they'll crawl away!
gui.guhs.creche.titel.go.sub: Right-click a baby guh and bring it back
gui.guhs.creche.liedje.uitleg: Press space (or click) when a little star is in the moon. Gently rock along...
gui.guhs.creche.liedje.gelukt: Zzz... the baby guh is asleep! Sweet dreams.
gui.guhs.creche.liedje.mislukt: The baby guh is still awake. One more time?
gui.guhs.theehuis.knop.start.tooltip: Your tame guhs (up to 6) sit down at the tea table: pour tea and serve something yummy
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.uitleg: Fancy a tea party? %s of your tame guhs can join. Pour tea, serve something yummy and chat away. A snug table makes everyone cozy!
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.feest: The Great Cozyfest! After a snug tea party I'll lend you my party tea set. %s of your tame guhs can join.
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.geen_guhs: I don't see any of your tame guhs nearby, dearie. Bring them along and we'll set the table!
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.bezig: %s is hosting a tea party right now. Come back in a bit!
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.bezig_jij: Your tea party is going: snugness %s of %s.
gui.guhs.theehuis.scherm.tip: Tip: you brew tea in a teapot.
gui.guhs.theehuis.wil_thee: %s would love a cup of tea!
gui.guhs.theehuis.kletst: %s is having a snug little chat.
gui.guhs.theehuis.heeft_al: %s still has plenty, thank you! Nyeg.
gui.guhs.theehuis.vergeten: %s wanted something else... oh well, chatting is nice too.
gui.guhs.theehuis.theepotje.leeg: Put something yummy in it: cheese nibbles, cheese milk, tea herb or guh flowers.
gui.guhs.kapper.alleen_eigen: Nyeg! Only your own tame guh can go to the hair salon.
gui.guhs.kapper.eerst_kapsel: Nyeg, a hairstyle first! You can't dye bald little tufts.
gui.guhs.kapper.geverfd: %s now has %s hair. Pretty as a picture!
gui.guhs.kapper.al_kaal: Nyeg, there's nothing left to snip.
gui.guhs.kapper.kaal: Snip snip snip... %s is back to au naturel. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.kapper.geen_kapsel: %s doesn't have a hairstyle yet. Buy one from Curly the Barber!
gui.guhs.kapper.uitleg: Customers sit down in the chair one by one, with a photo of the hairstyle they want. Wash, snip, dye, blow-dry: the faster and neater, the more points and Curl Coins!
gui.guhs.kapper.bezet: %s is putting on a salon show right now. Only one at a time: watch along and wait your turn!
gui.guhs.kapper.start.tooltip: 8 customers, each with their own wish. During the show you don't get hungry or hurt.
gui.guhs.kapper.feest.tooltip: For the Great Cozyfest: score at least %s points and you get the Party Hairdo Kit
gui.guhs.kapper.shop.tooltip: Hairstyles and hair dye for your own guh, the barber's cape and salon furniture, for Curl Coins
gui.guhs.kapper.geen_best: No record yet: time for a show!
gui.guhs.kapper.munten: Curl Coins in your pocket: %s (1 per 20 points +1)
gui.guhs.kapper.eerste: At your first show you get a little welcome gift!
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.wassen.tooltip: Lather three times, then the hair is clean enough to snip
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.fohn.tooltip: Done? The hair dryer finishes it off and the customer leaves happy. Take one more look at the photo first!
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.stop.tooltip: The show stops; you get the Curl Coins for your points
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.sluit.tooltip: The screen closes, the show goes on! Right-click the customer to come back
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.aftellen: Ready, set... the first customer is coming in any moment!
gui.guhs.kapper.knip.volgende: Ding-a-ling... here comes the next customer!
gui.guhs.boerderij.blij.guhschaapje: The guh lamb is super happy! Baa-baa!
